commit.message:
fix(ci): reap owned Chrome descendants before removing the CDP profile

Keep browser, server and probe lifecycles under a dedicated Linux owner.
Preserve the original CDP assertions and failure codes; verify cleanup with
real process regressions and publish its receipt alongside browser evidence.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Own and reap the Linux-only CDP reference's temporary process trees."""
+
+import argparse
+import ctypes
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+
+class Interrupted(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, signum):
+        self.signum = signum
+
+
+class OwnedProcesses:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.owner = os.getpid()
+        self.processes = []
+        self.report = {"owner_pid": self.owner, "owned_sessions": [],
+                       "term_used": False, "escalated_to_kill": False,
+                       "reaped_pids": [], "remaining_live_children": []}
+        if os.readlink("/proc/self") != str(self.owner):
+            raise RuntimeError("procfs does not use this owner's PID namespace")
+        if self.children():
+            raise RuntimeError("CDP owner must start without existing children")
+        # Reparent double-forked/session-escaping Chrome helpers to this owner.
+        libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
+        libc.prctl.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int] + [ctypes.c_ulong] * 4
+        libc.prctl.restype = ctypes.c_int
+        if libc.prctl(36, 1, 0, 0, 0):  # PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER
+            raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), "PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER failed")
+        signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD, signal.SIG_DFL)
+
+    def children(self):
+        path = Path(f"/proc/self/task/{self.owner}/children")
+        try:
+            candidates = path.read_text().split()
+            direct_list = True
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            # Some Linux sandboxes omit task/children. Read only stat metadata
+            # and retain only our own children; never inspect argv or env.
+            candidates = [item.name for item in Path("/proc").iterdir() if item.name.isdecimal()]
+            direct_list = False
+        result = []
+        for value in candidates:
+            pid = int(value)
+            try:
+                fields = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat").read_text().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()
+            except FileNotFoundError:
+                continue
+            if int(fields[1]) != self.owner:
+                if direct_list:
+                    raise RuntimeError("Child ownership changed before cleanup")
+                continue
+            result.append((pid, fields[0]))
+        return sorted(result)
+
+    def start(self, command, log=None):
+        process = subprocess.Popen(
+            command, start_new_session=True, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+            stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT if log is not None else None,
+        )
+        self.processes.append(process)
+        if os.getpgid(process.pid) != process.pid or os.getsid(process.pid) != process.pid:
+            raise RuntimeError("Temporary service did not acquire its own session")
+        self.report["owned_sessions"].append(
+            {"pid": process.pid, "pgid": process.pid, "sid": process.pid})
+        return process
+
+    def group_signal(self, signum):
+        for process in self.processes:
+            # Never poll()/wait() these leaders before the final reap. Their
+            # unreaped PIDs pin the group identities even after early exit.
+            try:
+                os.killpg(process.pid, signum)
+            except ProcessLookupError:
+                pass
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def live_children(children):
+        # A thread-group leader may show Z after pthread_exit while its other
+        # threads still write. Only an exit waitable without reaping is dead.
+        return [pid for pid, _state in children
+                if os.waitid(os.P_PID, pid, os.WEXITED | os.WNOHANG | os.WNOWAIT) is None]
+
+    def await_quiet(self, signum, seconds):
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
+        signaled = set()
+        while True:
+            children = self.children()
+            live = self.live_children(children)
+            self.report["remaining_live_children"] = live
+            if not live:
+                # Reparenting can add an orphan while the first snapshot is
+                # read. Require a stable, wholly dead set before final reap.
+                again = self.children()
+                if again == children:
+                    return True
+            # Only this dedicated subreaper's unreaped children are eligible.
+            # This also covers adopted descendants that created new sessions.
+            for pid in live:
+                if pid not in signaled:
+                    os.kill(pid, signum)
+                    signaled.add(pid)
+            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                self.report["remaining_live_children"] = live
+                return False
+            time.sleep(0.02)
+
+    def close(self, term_seconds, kill_seconds):
+        self.report["term_used"] = bool(self.processes or self.children())
+        self.group_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
+        if not self.await_quiet(signal.SIGTERM, term_seconds):
+            self.report["escalated_to_kill"] = True
+            self.group_signal(signal.SIGKILL)
+            if not self.await_quiet(signal.SIGKILL, kill_seconds):
+                raise RuntimeError("Owned descendants survived SIGKILL; profile retained")
+        # No signals follow this point: reaping may release the pinned IDs.
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + kill_seconds
+        while True:
+            try:
+                pid, status = os.waitpid(-1, os.WNOHANG)
+            except ChildProcessError:
+                break
+            if pid:
+                self.report["reaped_pids"].append(pid)
+                for process in self.processes:
+                    if process.pid == pid:
+                        process.returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
+            elif time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                raise RuntimeError("Owned descendants could not be reaped; profile retained")
+            else:
+                time.sleep(0.02)
+        self.report["remaining_live_children"] = []
+
+
+def run_session(profile, evidence, chrome_command, http_command, probe_command,
+                term_seconds=3.0, kill_seconds=3.0):
+    owner = OwnedProcesses()
+    original_status = 1
+    profile_created = False
+    lifecycle_error = None
+    cleanup_error = None
+    closing = False
+
+    def interrupted(signum, _frame):
+        if not closing:
+            raise Interrupted(signum)
+
+    old_handlers = {sig: signal.signal(sig, interrupted) for sig in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM)}
+    try:
+        profile.mkdir(mode=0o700)
+        profile_created = True
+        with (evidence / "http-server.log").open("w") as http_log, \
+                (evidence / "chrome.log").open("w") as chrome_log:
+            owner.start(http_command, http_log)
+            chrome = owner.start(chrome_command, chrome_log)
+            probe = owner.start(probe_command + [str(chrome.pid)])
+            # Observe the probe result without releasing its PID/group anchor.
+            result = os.waitid(os.P_PID, probe.pid, os.WEXITED | os.WNOWAIT)
+            original_status = result.si_status if result.si_code == os.CLD_EXITED else 128 + result.si_status
+    except Interrupted as error:
+        original_status = 128 + error.signum
+    except Exception as error:
+        lifecycle_error = str(error)
+        print(f"CDP lifecycle failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+    finally:
+        closing = True
+        try:
+            owner.close(term_seconds, kill_seconds)
+            if profile_created:
+                # All descendants are dead and reaped before the one removal.
+                shutil.rmtree(profile)
+        except Exception as error:
+            cleanup_error = str(error)
+            print(f"CDP cleanup failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+            try:
+                owner.report["remaining_live_children"] = owner.live_children(owner.children())
+            except Exception as inspection_error:
+                owner.report["remaining_live_children"] = None
+                owner.report["remaining_children_inspection_error"] = str(inspection_error)
+        report = {**owner.report, "probe_exit_status": original_status,
+                  "lifecycle_error": lifecycle_error,
+                  "cleanup_exit_status": 1 if cleanup_error else 0,
+                  "final_exit_status": original_status or (1 if cleanup_error or lifecycle_error else 0),
+                  "cleanup_error": cleanup_error, "profile_removed": profile_created and not profile.exists()}
+        try:
+            (evidence / "process-cleanup.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
+        except Exception as error:
+            cleanup_error = cleanup_error or str(error)
+            print(f"CDP cleanup evidence failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        for sig, handler in old_handlers.items():
+            signal.signal(sig, handler)
+    return original_status if original_status else (1 if cleanup_error or lifecycle_error else 0)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--profile", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--evidence", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--port", required=True, type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("probe", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    probe = args.probe[1:] if args.probe[:1] == ["--"] else args.probe
+    if not probe:
+        parser.error("A probe command is required")
+    chrome = ["google-chrome", "--headless=new", "--no-sandbox", "--disable-gpu",
+              "--disable-dev-shm-usage", "--disable-background-networking", "--no-first-run",
+              "--no-default-browser-check", "--disable-extensions", "--remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1",
+              "--remote-debugging-port=0", "--remote-allow-origins=*", f"--user-data-dir={args.profile}",
+              "about:blank"]
+    http = [sys.executable, "-m", "http.server", str(args.port), "--bind", "127.0.0.1",
+            "--directory", str(args.evidence / "html")]
+    return run_session(args.profile, args.evidence, chrome, http, probe)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Real Linux process regressions for the CI-only browser owner."""
+
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+import unittest
+
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+CHROME = r'''
+import ctypes, os, signal, sys, threading, time
+from pathlib import Path
+profile, ready, mode = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
+child = os.fork()
+if child:
+    os._exit(0)
+os.setsid()
+if mode in ("ignore-term", "threaded-ignore-term"):
+    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
+directory = profile / "Default"
+directory.mkdir()
+(directory / "still-writing").write_text(str(time.monotonic_ns()))
+ready.with_suffix(".tmp").write_text(str(os.getpid()))
+ready.with_suffix(".tmp").replace(ready)
+def write_forever():
+    while True:
+        (directory / "still-writing").write_text(str(time.monotonic_ns()))
+        time.sleep(0.005)
+if mode == "threaded-ignore-term":
+    threading.Thread(target=write_forever).start()
+    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None)
+    libc.pthread_exit.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
+    libc.pthread_exit(None)
+else:
+    write_forever()
+'''
+PROBE = r'''
+import sys, time
+from pathlib import Path
+ready, release, observed = map(Path, sys.argv[1:4])
+status, leader = sys.argv[4:6]
+deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
+while not ready.exists() or not release.exists():
+    if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+        raise RuntimeError("Fixture handshake timed out")
+    time.sleep(0.005)
+while True:
+    state = Path(f"/proc/{leader}/stat").read_text().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()[0]
+    if state == "Z":
+        break
+    if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+        raise RuntimeError("Early-exited leader was not retained")
+    time.sleep(0.005)
+observed.write_text(state)
+if status == "hang":
+    time.sleep(60)
+else:
+    raise SystemExit(int(status))
+'''
+DRIVER = r'''
+import json, sys
+from pathlib import Path
+sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
+import rea_browser_session as session
+config = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text())
+if config["stale_snapshot"]:
+    actual_children = session.OwnedProcesses.children
+    injected = False
+    def one_pre_adoption_snapshot(self):
+        global injected
+        children = actual_children(self)
+        leaders = {process.pid for process in self.processes}
+        roots = [(pid, state) for pid, state in children if pid in leaders]
+        orphan_is_live = any(pid not in leaders and state not in ("Z", "X")
+                             for pid, state in children)
+        if not injected and len(roots) == 3 and orphan_is_live and all(state == "Z" for _, state in roots):
+            # Emulate a procfs PID list sampled before reparenting, followed
+            # by stat reads after the leaders died. The orphan is real.
+            injected = True
+            (Path(config["evidence"]) / "stale-snapshot-injected").write_text("once")
+            return roots
+        return children
+    session.OwnedProcesses.children = one_pre_adoption_snapshot
+if config["cleanup_failure"]:
+    def refuse_removal(_path):
+        raise PermissionError("injected profile removal failure")
+    session.shutil.rmtree = refuse_removal
+raise SystemExit(session.run_session(
+    Path(config["profile"]), Path(config["evidence"]), config["chrome"],
+    config["http"], config["probe"], term_seconds=0.15, kill_seconds=1.0))
+'''
+SENTINEL = r'''
+import sys, time
+from pathlib import Path
+path = Path(sys.argv[1])
+while True:
+    path.write_text(str(time.monotonic_ns()))
+    time.sleep(0.005)
+'''
+
+
+class BrowserSessionTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def wait_for(self, predicate, process):
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
+        while not predicate():
+            if process.poll() is not None:
+                stdout, stderr = process.communicate()
+                self.fail(f"Owner exited before handshake: {process.returncode}\n{stdout}\n{stderr}")
+            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                self.fail("Fixture handshake timed out")
+            time.sleep(0.005)
+
+    def exercise(self, *, mode="ignore-term", status="0", cleanup_failure=False,
+                 cancel=False, stale_snapshot=False):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rea-browser-owner-") as root:
+            root = Path(root)
+            evidence, profile = root / "evidence", root / "profile"
+            evidence.mkdir()
+            ready, release, observed = root / "child-ready", root / "release", root / "probe-observed"
+            heartbeat = root / "unrelated-heartbeat"
+            config = {"profile": str(profile), "evidence": str(evidence),
+                      "cleanup_failure": cleanup_failure,
+                      "stale_snapshot": stale_snapshot,
+                      "chrome": [sys.executable, "-c", CHROME, str(profile), str(ready), mode],
+                      "http": [sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(60)"],
+                      "probe": [sys.executable, "-c", PROBE, str(ready), str(release),
+                                str(observed), status]}
+            config_path = root / "config.json"
+            config_path.write_text(json.dumps(config))
+            # This sibling is deliberately outside the owner's child trees.
+            sentinel = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", SENTINEL, str(heartbeat)],
+                                        start_new_session=True)
+            owner = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", DRIVER, str(HERE), str(config_path)],
+                                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True,
+                                     start_new_session=True)
+            child_fd = None
+            try:
+                self.wait_for(lambda: ready.exists() and heartbeat.exists(), owner)
+                child_pid = int(ready.read_text())
+                # A stable handle lets fixture failure cleanup avoid PID reuse.
+                child_fd = os.pidfd_open(child_pid)
+                before = heartbeat.read_text()
+                self.assertTrue((profile / "Default" / "still-writing").exists())
+                if mode == "threaded-ignore-term":
+                    def leader_is_zombie():
+                        return Path(f"/proc/{child_pid}/stat").read_text().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()[0] == "Z"
+                    self.wait_for(leader_is_zombie, owner)
+                    written = (profile / "Default" / "still-writing").read_text()
+                    self.wait_for(lambda: (profile / "Default" / "still-writing").read_text()
+                                  not in ("", written), owner)
+                release.write_text("ready")
+                self.wait_for(observed.exists, owner)
+                self.assertEqual(observed.read_text(), "Z")
+                if cancel:
+                    owner.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
+                stdout, stderr = owner.communicate(timeout=6)
+                report = json.loads((evidence / "process-cleanup.json").read_text())
+                self.assertEqual(report["owner_pid"], owner.pid)
+                self.assertEqual(report["remaining_live_children"], [])
+                self.assertIn(child_pid, report["reaped_pids"])
+                self.assertFalse(Path(f"/proc/{child_pid}").exists(), stderr)
+                self.assertEqual(len(report["owned_sessions"]), 3)
+                for item in report["owned_sessions"]:
+                    self.assertEqual(item["pid"], item["pgid"])
+                    self.assertEqual(item["pid"], item["sid"])
+                    self.assertIn(item["pid"], report["reaped_pids"])
+                    self.assertFalse(Path(f"/proc/{item['pid']}").exists())
+                self.assertTrue(report["term_used"])
+                self.assertEqual(report["escalated_to_kill"], mode != "term")
+                expected_probe = 143 if cancel else int(status)
+                expected_exit = expected_probe or (1 if cleanup_failure else 0)
+                self.assertEqual(report["probe_exit_status"], expected_probe)
+                self.assertEqual(report["cleanup_exit_status"], int(cleanup_failure))
+                self.assertEqual(report["final_exit_status"], expected_exit)
+                self.assertEqual(owner.returncode, expected_exit, stdout + stderr)
+                self.assertEqual(profile.exists(), cleanup_failure)
+                self.assertEqual(report["profile_removed"], not cleanup_failure)
+                if stale_snapshot:
+                    self.assertEqual((evidence / "stale-snapshot-injected").read_text(), "once")
+                if cleanup_failure:
+                    self.assertIn("injected profile removal failure", report["cleanup_error"])
+                else:
+                    self.assertIsNone(report["cleanup_error"])
+                self.assertIsNone(sentinel.poll(), "Unrelated sentinel was killed")
+                self.wait_for(lambda: heartbeat.read_text() not in ("", before), sentinel)
+                print(json.dumps({"case": self.id(), "result": "PASS", "cleanup": report}, sort_keys=True))
+            finally:
+                if owner.poll() is None:
+                    owner.terminate()
+                    try:
+                        owner.communicate(timeout=4)
+                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                        owner.kill()
+                        owner.communicate()
+                else:
+                    owner.communicate()
+                if child_fd is not None:
+                    try:
+                        signal.pidfd_send_signal(child_fd, signal.SIGKILL)
+                    except ProcessLookupError:
+                        pass
+                    os.close(child_fd)
+                sentinel.terminate()
+                sentinel.wait(timeout=3)
+
+    def test_exited_parent_session_escaping_writer_is_killed_and_reaped(self):
+        self.exercise()
+
+    def test_term_cooperative_orphan_needs_no_kill(self):
+        self.exercise(mode="term")
+
+    def test_new_orphan_after_dead_snapshot_is_signaled_before_reap(self):
+        self.exercise(stale_snapshot=True)
+
+    def test_zombie_thread_leader_with_live_writer_is_not_treated_as_dead(self):
+        self.exercise(mode="threaded-ignore-term")
+
+    def test_probe_failure_is_preserved_after_cleanup(self):
+        self.exercise(status="37")
+
+    def test_probe_failure_wins_over_removal_failure(self):
+        self.exercise(status="37", cleanup_failure=True)
+
+    def test_removal_failure_turns_probe_success_into_failure(self):
+        self.exercise(cleanup_failure=True)
+
+    def test_cancellation_cleans_descendants_and_retains_signal_status(self):
+        self.exercise(status="hang", cancel=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
